SHARPNESS AND THE STRONGER ORDINARY INCUMBENT
31 October 2026. Clarification after the frozen kinetic draws; no redraws.

The phrase "same binomial calibration" in the frozen METROLOGY.txt and
kinetic_design.json refers to the BINOMIAL MGF and its CHERNOFF inversion.
M1 is sharp as an mgf inequality. It does not by itself prove that each
discrete tail is bounded by the exact binomial tail, nor that the
implemented confidence endpoint is statistically optimal. That stronger
tail statement for the unrestricted hidden CTMC class remains UNPROVED.
The finite cycle search in kinetic_tail_search.json did not refute it;
that floating diagnostic does not establish it.

On the specified validation sources, observed flips really ARE iid
Bernoulli. An ordinary exact binomial-tail (Clopper-Pearson) lower interval
is therefore a stronger matched incumbent than ordinary Chernoff
inversion. We implemented that incumbent on the SAME already acquired
records, clock rate, checkpoints and error allocations. The initial
frozen protocol and draws remain preserved; this comparison is a
post-draw analysis with no additional acquisitions or selected data.

For N intervals, d>0 changes and null probability q<d/N,

 Pr{Bin(N,q)>=d}=binom(N,d)q^d(1-q)^(N-d) S,
 S=1+rho_d+rho_d rho_(d+1)+...,
 rho_k=[(N-k)/(k+1)] q/(1-q).

These ratios decrease and are below one. Positive fixed-point arithmetic
rounds every recurrence down/up. A truncated upper sum adds the remaining
geometric tail. The large integer binomial coefficient is computed
exactly, then enclosed between its leading-96-bit dyadic truncation and
the next dyadic value. Certified rational logarithms enclose the pmf and
S; no large-factorial floating approximation decides validity.

SciPy inverse-beta values propose endpoints only. For each proposed lower
q the receiver proves log(tail_upper)<=log(alpha_lower), and for the
upper q proves log(tail_lower)>=log(alpha_upper). Thus it brackets the
exact ordinary lower endpoint. The binomial-to-kinetic transformation
q -> nu q/(1-2q) applies to these iid-flip sources. A general hidden
record is not licensed to use that extra iid premise.

131 small rational exact-tail controls passed. The retained source ends
at 3.5450360258 under the ordinary exact-tail incumbent versus 3.4942873285
under the all-hidden Chernoff band. Its first certified crossing of rate3
is at11,972 versus23,405 inter

FINITE-RECORD METROLOGY OF REQUIRED HIDDEN KINETIC CAPACITY
Solo derivation, 31 October 2026. A maximum rate, not mean activity or heat.

1. THE PHYSICAL OPERATION

Observe a fixed deterministic binary label of a stationary, homogeneous
hidden CTMC at a known independent Poisson clock of rate nu. No hidden
state count, rates, stationary probabilities or mixing bound is input.
Let kappa=max_x q_x (essential supremum on stationary support for Borel
models), the MAXIMUM total microscopic escape rate. It is not the
stationary mean jump activity, and not an entropy-production rate.

We construct a finite-confidence lower bound on kappa from one dependent
record, sharp on equilibrium two-state kinetics. This result needs no
physical reversal convention, because it makes no thermodynamic claim.
Stationary preparation, noninvasive deterministic state sensing and an
independent calibrated Poisson clock are still external premises.

Let D_N count changes between N consecutive inspected binary labels.
If kappa<=Lambda, set

       r=Lambda/(nu+2Lambda), c=1-r.

For EVERY such hidden model and every theta>=0,

        E exp(theta D_N)<=[c+r exp(theta)]^N.              (M1)

This is exactly the binomial mgf with parameter r, despite dependence
and arbitrary hidden state count. It is a stationary norm inequality,
not an assertion that the observed likelihood ratio is a martingale.

2. PROOF FROM ONE COHERENT GENERATOR

Write P=I+Q/Lambda and s=Lambda/(nu+Lambda). P is a contraction on L2(pi).
Its disk automorphism

             C=(P-sI)(I-sP)^(-1)

is a contraction: multiplying the defect on both sides gives

 I-C*C=(1-s^2)(I-sP*)^(-1)(I-P*P)(I-sP)^(-1)>=0.

The TRUE independent-inspection kernel B=nu(nu I-Q)^(-1) satisfies

                       B=cI+rC.                          (M2)

For F multiplication by the binary label f=+/-1, F*F=I. The edge tilt
for S_N=sum f(Y_j)f(Y_{j+1})=N-2D_N is

 K_lambda=cosh(lambda) B-sinh(lambda) FBF
         =c exp(-lambda)I+r[cosh(lambda)C-sinh(lambda)FCF].

Therefore ||K_lambda||<=c exp(-lambda)+r exp(lambda). Stationarity writes
the N-edge expectation as <1,K_lambda^N 1>, so operator norms give
E exp(-lambda S_N)<=[c exp(-lambda)+r exp(lambda)]^N.
Put theta=2lambda and cancel exp(-lambda N) to obtain(M1).
No conditional observed concentration, spectral gap, independence of
overlapping pairs, or hidden-clock observations were assumed
